title: std::stack<T,Container>::~stack
summary: A destructor. Destructs the stack. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.
html:
~stack();

A destructor. Destructs the stack. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the stack.
